text:
jeff-sales: FYI FinScope POC hitting multiple issues — 'dims mismatch' in rerank + occasional 413/429 on embeddings encode. Customer wants a quick triage. Logs uploaded: https://s3.internal/finscope/poc-logs.tar.gz :exclamation:

amanda-sales: Also flagged pricing/Q on dims change (if they move to larger embed model). They want Dedicated if we can't hit latency.

ali-se: I'm free to jump on this now. Jeff, can you paste the embed model name they think they're using, a sample request, and their SDK version?

jeff-sales: model: "open-embed-1024" per their code, but their client reports `embeddings.shape` as 1536. sample request:
```json
{"model":"open-embed-1024","input":["doc1","doc2"],"batch_size":128}
```
SDK: python 0.8.1

chris-eng-ml: Quick hypothesis: dims mismatch means they're actually calling a 1536 model somewhere (or a third-party encoder produced different pooling). Also batch_size=128 may be collapsing into a single huge request and triggering payload limits/rate limit spikes (413 / 429).

lena-support: FYI we have a per-key rate cap on this account (free-tier default) at ~100 req/min. One big batched request can cause a surge. Recommend reducing batch_size and adding retries/backoff.

ali-se: Steps to triage: 1) confirm model metadata (dims) via metadata API 2) check client SDK caching bug in python 0.8.1 (fixed in 0.9.2) 3) reduce `batch_size` to 32-64 and add incremental retries. Example metadata curl:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/open-embed-1024/metadata
```
Response will include `embedding_dim`.

chris-eng-ml: Also check client-side pooling/dtype — dtype (fp16/float32) shouldn't change dims, but custom pooling or concatenation can. If they run an offline encoder and re-ingest, dims can mismatch.

jeff-sales: Customer ran the metadata check I asked for — they told me their env reports `model: open-embed-1536` even though their code points at 1024. Looks like they have mixed configs across services.

amanda-sales: Heads up on pricing: 1536-dim embeddings will increase per-embedding unit cost ~1.5x. Sent the updated pricing matrix to the contact. Also mentioned Dedicated as an option for consistent throughput.

lena-support: For an immediate mitigation I've recommended: 1) set `batch_size=32` 2) upgrade SDK to 0.9.2 (fixes caching issue) 3) if they need to keep 1536 vectors, reindex their DB to 1536 dims or switch to open-embed-1024 to match existing index. I'll DM step-by-step. :memo:

chris-eng-ml: I'll add a small improvement to the API error text to include expected dims vs provided dims so customers can triage faster. Can push in the next deploy window (about 20m). deploy-bot, FYI.

deploy-bot: Started deploy #4521 for eng-ml (includes clearer dims error text).

jeff-sales: Customer will reindex to 1536 to move quickly. Scheduling a quick sync in 30m to validate and run final end-to-end. Thanks all :pray:
